programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species...and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it...literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before...and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming ...human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real...and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Asustados por la inseguridad y temiendo perder su fortuna, Vítor y Albertano deciden comprar un rancho e irse a vivir al campo, pero los peligros de la ciudad no son nada comparados con el terror que acecha en ese lugar.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Justito quiere pasar el examen de niños genio, pero cuidar a su hermanito podría arruinarlo. Además, Plácido está decidido a regresar a México, pero una tarea en Acapulco lo hará dudar de su decisión.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Un descuido provoca que la cocina explote, por lo que deberán conseguir dinero para arreglarla. Mientras tanto, Plácido está desesperado por ver a su familia, así que idea un plan para volver.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El departamento de abajo queda en renta nuevamente y la familia López buscará una forma de rentarlo. Mientras tanto, hay una oportunidad en el colegio de genios, por lo que Justito podría dejar a sus papás.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el Poncholín colorado y el Poncho del ocho, un homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chica que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que ella lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.
programme.sub-title: El amor que se hace nudo

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.
programme.sub-title: El Valiente Vive, hasta que el Cobarde Quiere

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Lucía es una chica que descubre la infidelidad de su novio. Lucía tiene una infección en los ojos y su madre compra un medicamento económico que le provoca ceguera. La joven culpa a su mamá de su desgracia, pero pronto su vida cambiará.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven cantante conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.
programme.sub-title: No todo lo que brilla es oro

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.
programme.sub-title: Lo que no fue en tu año

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el Poncholín colorado y el Poncho del ocho, un homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chica que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que ella lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.
programme.sub-title: El amor que se hace nudo

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.

programme.desc: Un joven regresa a su pueblo y se entera de que su padre ha muerto. El chico amenaza a un hombre cuando descubre que quiere abusar de su novia. El hombre mata a la madre del chico para quedarse con sus tierras.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una jovencita es golpeada por su padre, y para proteger a su madre, no se queja de nada. La mamá de la niña se la pasa tomando pastillas para dormir y descuida a su hija. La maestra se da cuenta de que es maltratada por sus padres.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una mujer se casa con un hombre muy celoso, con el paso del tiempo se entera de que su exmujer se suicidó por culpa de la enfermedad de su marido y pide ayuda para escapar.
programme.sub-title: Aunque la Jaula sea de Oro

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un señor sufre un accidente en una construcción. Un joven que trabaja en la construcción queda impactado con el accidente de uno de sus compañeros. La hermana del joven sufre de bullying por ser indígena.
programme.sub-title: No tiene la Culpa el Indio

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven se embaraza del novio de su mejor amiga, la chica oculta la identidad del padre de su hijo. Durante su embarazo la chica les dice a sus amigas que no quiere a su hijo y desea que el bebé nazca sin vida.
programme.sub-title: El Que Esté Libre de Pecado

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Liz se embaraza de Saúl, su novio, pero no quiere hacerse responsable. Liz tiene un padre autoritario al cual no le tiene confianza, pero sin querer, se entera de que su hija está embarazada. Él les obliga a casarse, pero todo es un fracaso.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven que es muy celosa golpea a una chica y le prohíbe hablarle a su novio. Un día la chica y su novio terminan y él le confiesa que está enamorado de otra chica. La joven le pide al chico que vaya a su casa y lo secuestra.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven vive con su abuela, pero la señora la trata muy mal porque ella es hija de la sirvienta. El hijo de la señora pierde su casa en un juego y le pide a su madre que deje que él y su familia vivan con ella.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven está obsesionada con la muerte de su padre, cree que él quiere comunicarse con ella para darle un mensaje. La joven cree que el mejor amigo de su papá y su mamá son amantes, y que ellos tuvieron que ver con la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven debe dinero de drogas y decide irse a vivir con sus tíos a otra ciudad para escapar, pero lo siguen para cobrarle todo el dinero que debe. El joven se roba la tarjeta de su tía y saca el dinero, pero el cobrador se lo quita todo.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven se va de su casa porque su padrastro lo maltrataba, su abuela se pasa buscándolo, pero él no quiere regresar con su familia y conoce a una mujer que lo utiliza para robar al lado de otros niños de la calle.
programme.sub-title: A cada uno le toca escoger

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita encuentra el diario de Mía en las cosas de Nico. Por su parte, Franco le pide a Mía que no crea en los chismes que inventan de su mamá. Luego, Madariaga le avisa a Pascual que no aceptara el cargo de Director.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel cenan junto al papá de Mía. Por su parte, Luján es expulsada del colegio por golpear al prefecto. Diego se pasa con el alcohol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le pide a Raquel que le haga creer a Miguel que se muere por él cuando esté solo o con Julieta; Pilar no cree que Joaquín la dejó y sospecha que está embarazada; Paola busca a Diego para decirle la verdad sobre su vida.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Galia le dice a Pascual que Pilar podría estar embarazada y ambos se culpan. Por su parte, Mía descubre el pasado de su mamá. Mientras tanto, Diego se reconcilia con Paola y la esconde para que se quede en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni apoya a Mía después de descubrir la manera en que murió su mamá. Por su parte, Roberta regresa de España y le manda un mensaje a José, para poder verla. Mientras tanto, Mía acepta que su mamá era una cualquiera, después de hablar con Valeria y saber la verdad.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta descubre la relación que tiene Diego con Paola. Por su lado, Mía se va del colegio y le deja una carta a Celina. En tanto, Miguel, con ayuda de Mayra, sale del colegio para buscarla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni se molesta al enterarse de que Miguel fue a buscar a Mía. Por su parte, Roberta encuentra a Mía con Alma y se siente traicionada. Luego, Alma le dice a Madariaga que Mía está con ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: José le dice a Roberta que se supone que ella anda con Teo. Por su lado, Miguel termina con Julieta. Finalmente, Pilar le cuenta a Lupita que está embarazada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta por celos, le pide a Alma elegir entre Mía y ella. Por su parte, Miguel le dice a Giovanni que Mía no es para él, y luego le confiesa a Mía lo que siente por ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco cree que Alma es quien pone a Mía en su contra. Por su lado, Miguel no quiere seguir ocultando su relación con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma llega a casa de Franco y la besa estando borracho. Por su parte, Nico trata de que Miguel asuma que es novio de Mía. Finalmente, Mía le confiesa a Giovanni que está enamorada de otro y termina con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los chicos salen a la discoteca y tratan de ligar con unas chavas de la escuela religiosa. Por su parte, Mía no quiere tener relaciones con Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La banda toca en un café. Por su parte, Diego se reconcilia con Paola. Además, Mía quiere saber de su madre e intenta saber la verdad.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León le dice a Alma que Roberta y Diego pasaron la noche juntos. Por su parte, Giovanni sustituye a Diego y participa en la carrera de jinetes. Además, Pilar se hace la prueba de embarazo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y su papá se encuentran a Alma en la playa, Roberta cubre a Diego en un problema con su papá. Por su parte, León se enfurece al descubrir que Giovanni usurpó el lugar de Diego.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma tiene una discusión con Franco y lo avienta al mar por insinuar que es una mujer interesada. Diego es atrapado por los hombres de la logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego, Giovanni, Roberta, Lupita, Miguel y Mía tienen éxito en su show. Además, Mabel y Diego se encuentran en el café. Giovanni se avergüenza de su mamá cuando la mamá de Tomás la invita a su casa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luisa se entera de que Giovanni se avergüenza de ella, ya que intenta hacerle creer a Tomás que ella no es su madre, pues no quiere que descubra la verdad. Luisa le dice a Nora que Giovanni no es su verdadero hijo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita descubre que Nico sabe por qué Miguel actúa tan raro con Mía y trata de convencerlo de contarle la verdad. Mía le dice a Miguel que a veces siente que no la quiere por la forma en que la trata.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Carlo le dice a Franco que quiere volver a trabajar en la empresa. Lupita descubre que Miguel quiere vengarse de la familia de Mía y trata de descubrir por qué.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita sigue a Miguel y lo encuentra besando a otra mujer. Miguel le confiesa a Julieta que está enamorado de Mía y decide terminar su relación con ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita le dice a Mía que Miguel es su novio por una venganza. Como respuesta, Mía insulta a Miguel y les dice a todos que estuvo con él por una apuesta. Mientras tanto, Teo es nombrado por la logia como cuidador de cuarto.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta no quiere que la fama de su mamá opaque su carrera en la banda. Mientras tanto, Mía abofetea a Miguel. Sin piedad, Esteban se excede en sus castigos hacia los alumnos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Carlo le dice a Roberta que está interesado en su mamá y no en ella. Además, el Sr. Mendiola despide a Esteban y presenta a Gastón como el nuevo prefecto. Por su parte, José le confiesa a Teo que fue ella quien le escribía los mails y no Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía abandona la banda y a Miguel le da gusto, pero Diego le dice que sería un error. Por su parte, El Oso logra que Marcelino se vaya con él. La banda va a su entrevista con la disquera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los chicos de la banda necesitan ser invitados al programa Otro Rollo para darse a conocer. Celina y José planean reencontrar a la maestra Hilda con su amor del pasado, para salvarse del examen. Franco le da otra oportunidad a Carlos para trabajar.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Tomás y Giovanni tratan de encubrir a Diego con Alicia. Por su parte, Madariaga se molesta con Gandía por contratar a una profesora solo por ser recomendada. Además, Rosa se quiere llevar a Lupita del colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina cae en la trampa de Gandía y delata a Roberta. Mabel encubre a los chicos y le dice a Gandía que ella autorizó su salida. Celina decide irse del colegio. Roberta le pide perdón a Teo. José culpa a Lupita de escribir los anónimos sobre Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mayra intenta que Lupita no se vaya con Rosa a Guadalajara. Mía, Giovanni, Miguel, Lupita, Diego y Roberta deciden que su banda se llame RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Adal Ramones escucha cantar a los chicos y los deja cantar en su programa. Celina, Vico, José, Nico y Tomás deben lograr que nadie vea el programa. RBD canta en el programa Otro Rollo. La policía le dice a Alma que encontraron el cadáver de un niño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina y Vico le cuentan a Mía lo que hicieron para que nadie los viera en televisión. Por otro lado, la cita de Hilda y su antiguo enamorado sale mal.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma pide ayuda en televisión para a encontrar a Marcelino. Lupita le dice a Madariaga que Roberta y Jose cometieron un error al pensar que el Sr. Calderón era el enamorado de Hilda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le ofrece su ayuda a Alma. Roberta besa a Diego. Paola le exige a Diego dejar su banda para que no esté cerca de Roberta. Nico le pide a Lupita que piense en su futuro y no deje el colegio. Marcelino llama a Roberta para despedirse.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego decide dejar la banda, pero Nico le dice que tiene un contrato firmado. Por su parte, Rosa lleva a Dulce al colegio para chantajear a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía inicia una campaña para ayudar a la conservación del Bosque de Chapultepec. Por su parte, Mayra felicita a Lupita por decidir quedarse en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego le confiesa a su mamá que la mujer que ama es Paola. Pascual no quiere que Galia trabaje en el colegio. Gastón amenaza a José. Roberta le pide a Facundo que no acepte a Diego en su banda. León recibe un correo con fotos de Diego y Paola.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta se enoja al saber que Alma es la maestra de coreografía. Por su parte, Mía se enoja con Miguel por inventar que sale con Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León amenaza a Paula y le da la oportunidad de terminar con Diego sin que sepa la verdad. Por su parte, la logia obliga a Teo a robarse la cartera de la profesora Renata.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta ayuda a Diego a escapar del colegio. Por su parte, Gandía le pide a José devolver lo que robó, para no expulsarla. Además, Paola le dice a Diego que quiere una vida nueva en donde nadie la conozca.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego se escapa con Paula y Roberta trata de impedirlo. Por su parte, Franco soborna a Alma para que se aleje de su familia. Mientras tanto, Roberta le dice a Paola que revele qué relación tenía con León.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma utiliza el dinero que le dio Franco para donarlo a una casa hogar para niños con cáncer a nombre de él. En tanto, los profesores son robados y sus pertenencias aparecen en el escritorio del director.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: José conoce a su tutor. Por su parte, los de la Logia están furiosos porque no lograron que José fuera expulsado. Además, Nico le dice a Teo que fue muy arriesgado su plan para ayudar a José.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta planea un viaje para que Mabel busque a Diego en Puebla. Por su parte, Franco descubre que Mía es modelo de una campaña de lencería. Además, Alma es amenazada por Coluchi.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía cree que olvidará a Miguel. Por su lado, Teo le dice a Miguel y Nico lo que pasó con el cuidador, y sospechan de Tomás y Giovanni.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León le dice a Mabel que Paola es prostituta. Mabel le pide a Roberta que le haga creer a León que Diego se fugó con ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Paola, en el Hospital, rechaza a Diego cuando ve que llega León. Por su parte, Nico le prohíbe a Tomás salir con Lupita. León le dice a Diego que Paola es una prostituta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar aconseja a Lupita; Gastón invita a Mía; Franco y Valeria van al colegio; creen que Mía los rechazó por Gastón; Giovanni contrata a unos actores para que sean sus papás.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Raquel descubre a los actores. Por su parte, León ve triste a Diego y le dice que el hombre debe dominar y se abrazan. Mientras tanto, Franco se entera de que Carlo fue preso por carreras clandestinas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina desea ser monja por Augusto. Por su lado, Paola busca a Diego para volver. Mientras tanto, Damiana hace una cena para Celina y Francisco. Además, Diego perdona a Paola y no regresan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Nico termina su noviazgo con Karen. Para herir a Roberta, Paola le dice que se reconcilió con Diego. Por su parte, Teo es aceptado en la Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita habla con Pilar y le dice que se la pasa bien con Tomás, pero con el solo escuchar el nombre de Nico, todo se le olvida. El padre de Diego le regala un auto lo cual le molesta, porque solo trata de comprar su cariño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Valeria le propone a Franco vivir juntos, él le dice que lo ha pensado, pero no puede porque Mía es su prioridad y debe estar libre para ella. Debido a la ruptura de Nico y Karen, el padre de ella le prohíbe ir al café y olvidarse de la banda.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plutarco y Adolfo hacen un casting para participar en luchas profesionales. Victoria se pone celosa porque Justito está enamorado de una chica nueva de su salón y ya no quiere jugar con ella.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plutarco y Gaby deciden buscar su propio departamento. Martina tiene mala suerte por no compartir una imagen en redes sociales. Tulio y Gertrudis son descubiertos besándose en el elevador.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Es Nochebuena y los López están tristes, ya que no tienen dinero para regalos ni para la cena, pero dos personas llegan sorpresivamente a cambiar la noche y hacer que sea una Navidad memorable para todos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Es el día del santoral de Plácido y quiere festejarlo con una cena, pero la falta de presupuesto complica el plan. Además, Tulio se fue de la casa y la familia debe decidir si Gertrudis se va o se queda con ellos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se queda sin pensión por error y debe conseguir un nuevo trabajo para mantener a su familia. Mientras tanto, un exnovio de la Nena vuelve para conquistarla, pero Adolfo trata de impedirlo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina convence a la tía Licha de hacerle una broma a la Nena para que no extrañe a Adolfo. Mientras tanto, Justito sufre las molestias de unos compañeros.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El exnovio de Carlos regresa a casa de los López para pedir asilo. Además, Plácido y Adolfo consiguen un nuevo trabajo, pero también una nueva deuda.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina quiere volverse influencer para mantenerse económicamente. El gobierno ha confiscado el departamento de Licha.

More than a decade after a teenage girl vanishes from a popular tourist destination, her killer is brought to justice; interviews with the FBI team who broke the case wide open and identified her killer.

programme.desc: When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme; "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Summoned by a long-lost spiritual soulmate, Xena (Lucy Lawless) heads for Japan with Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) on a daunting mission to save the city of Higuchi from destruction and make amends for her past.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) face the greatest threat they've ever known when they go up against the evil Yodoshi (Adrian Brown) and an army of 20,000 elite Samurai warriors.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena atones for her evil past by defending her home village from the marauding warlord Draco.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena defends a town against a band of thugs led by a father and son duo.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is kidnapped by a mystic, Xena enters an altered state of consciousness and must face ghosts from her past in order to rescue her friend.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena employs stealthy maneuvers to protect an infant who an oracle claims will one day usurp a king's throne.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena helps a prince rescue his fiancee who has been kidnapped by a greedy arms dealer opposed to their marriage.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Ares (Kevin Smith), the god of war, frames Xena (Lucy Lawless) for murder with the hope she will turn to him in desperation and become his evil ally. With Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When Gabrielle unknowingly utters a chant that releases three imprisoned Titans, Xena must figure out how to save innocent villagers.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle team up with Hercules and Iolaus to free the kidnapped Prometheus, the god responsible for making fire available to Earth.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When King Sisyphus captures Hades' sister Celesta, Xena and Gabrielle must free her before mankind is doomed to eternal suffering.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to prevent a war between the Amazons and the Centaurs by determining who killed an Amazon princess.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena comes to the aid of imprisoned freedom fighters who refuse to reveal the identity of their mysterious leader.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena joins the climactic battle between the warring Greeks and Trojans that is precipitated by the false peace offering of the Trojan horse.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Gabrielle cons her way into a prestigious storytelling competition and ends up helping a fellow bard who is under pressure from his father to win.
programme.sub-title: Athens City Academy of the Performing Bards

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: A hidden key to a chamber containing Ambrosia, which turns mortals into gods, will fall into the wrong hands if Xena does not find it first.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena trades identities with a look-alike princess in order to defeat the young woman's would-be assassins. Features Lucy Lawless in a dual role.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena crosses the river Styx to the Underworld to help her deceased lover stop a madman from destroying the heavenly Elysian Fields.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena forces a renowned thief to assist her in an elaborate scheme to recover a powerful weapon from a warlord.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Gabrielle takes on the role of leader when she returns home and finds her village ill-prepared to defend itself from a band of marauders.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: A boy will die in a sacrificial killing unless Xena can stop his jealous older brother.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: As the god Ares schemes to make Xena lead his army, the warrior princess meets a man claiming to be her long-lost father.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Gabrielle assumes Xena's identity after the warrior princess is injured during a skirmish with a warlord bent on destroying Salmoneus.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: The female warrior Callisto tries to turn the world against Xena by committing acts of terrorism in her name.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: After learning a raiding party's leader was responsible for the destruction in their village, Xena and her brother set out to destroy him.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle run a makeshift hospital for war casualties and attempt to convince a general that the bloody conflict should end.
programme.sub-title: Is There A Doctor in the House?

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena's deepest secret is revealed when she and Gabrielle join forces with the Centaurs to battle the evil warlord, Dagnine (Mark Ferguson).

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: The three Fates give Xena the chance to recreate her life when she agrees to give up her warrior ways.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena must face her old friend Goliath (Todd Rippon) in battle when the giant refuses to turn his back on the ruthless Philistines.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Orpheus (Matthew Chamberlain) to defeat the evil god Bacchus (Anthony Ray Parker), who is transforming innocent girls into deadly monsters.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When the fierce woman warrior Callisto (Hudson Leick) escapes from prison, Xena must face her in battle once again.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena must foil an attempt to dethrone her friend and look-alike, Princess Diana, by the unscrupulous Meg, who bears a startling resemblance to both.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: With the help of Ares (Kevin Smith) in the Underworld, Callisto (Hudson Leick) switches bodies with Xena and returns to the land of the living where the two women warriors battle once more, this time disguised as each other.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: While still trapped in the body of her enemy, Callisto, Xena is forced to enter a competition where warlords vie to become the new god of war.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to bring the warmth of the holiday season to a cold-hearted king (Peter Vere Jones) who has outlawed the Winter Solstice celebration.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: In 1940, two archaeologists look for the legendary scrolls that Gabrielle wrote about her adventures with Xena.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena masquerades as a beauty pageant contestant to stop a saboteur, who is bent on destroying a peace treaty between three warlords.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: After being critically injured in a fight, Xena lets her mind flash back to the time that Julius Caesar (Karl Urban) taught her a valuable lesson about destiny.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Gabrielle's attempt to take Xena's body to be buried with her brother are complicated by would-be thieves, Amazon dynasty squabbles, and Xena attempts to communicate through Autolycus.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: In order to stop the evil Velasca (Melinda Clarke) from hunting down Gabrielle, Xena must unleash an even more depraved immortal to vanquish her---Callisto (Hudson Leick).

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has 24 hours to prevent a warlord from plundering one village, and the world's biggest giant from destroying another.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: While engaged in a battle of wills with her son, Cupid, Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) turns Joxer into a dashing hero tasked with stealing a princess's heart away from her betrothed.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When Meleager, the hero who once saved Gabrielle's village, is condemned for murder, Gabrielle and Xena have only one turn of the sand dial to produce evidence that he is innocent.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: A warrior (Jeremy Callaghan) wants to make his name by killing Xena. He fails, but he succeeds in putting the warrior princess in a blind rage when he kidnaps Gabrielle and sells her to agents of a king.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle chance upon King Ulysses on his way home to Ithaca from Troy, and when they see that Poseidon doesn't want him to get there, they do everything they can to make sure that he does.

programme.title: Tyson's Run
programme.desc: When 15-year-old Tyson attends public school for the first time, his life changes forever.
